body.label: Effect
body.html: Establish a 1-unit Circle centered on yourself. Allies inside gain +1 Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: If this Rite names a creature or point, increase its triggering range by 1 unit.
Choose one creature or object affected by this Action as the Rite's sympathetic link. The Rite may trigger from that link within 6 units as though it were at the Rite's location.

rider.title: CIRCLE RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: An ally inside the Circle is targeted by an Action. Echo: That ally gains +1 Defense against the Action.
